title_o: Exposing Individuals to Foreign Accent Increases their Trust in What Nonnative Speakers Say

replications.quote: Although the current pattern of results differs from that of the original study, our finding that neither comprehension nor veracity were impacted by accent or exposure condition is not inconsistent with the Boduch-Grabka and Lev-Ari (2021) processing difficulty account of the accent-based veracity judgment effect.
